title: Trust and Obey
lyrics: [F]When we walk with [C7]the [F]Lord in the [C]light of [C7]His [F]word,
What a [Bb]glory He [F]sheds on our [C]way!
[F]While we do His [C7]good [F]will, He [C]abides with [C7]us [F]still,
And with [Bb]all who will [F]trust and [C7]obey.
[C]Trust and [F]obey, [F7]for there's [D]no other [Gm]way
To be [C7]happy in [F]Jesus, but to trust and [C7]obey.
When we [C]walk with [G7]the [C]Lord in the [G7]light of His [C]Word,
What a [G]glory He [C]sheds on our [G7]way!
While we [C]do His [G7]good [C]will He [G7]abides with us [C]still,
and with [F]all who will [C]trust and [G7]obey.
[G7]Trust and [C]obey, For there's [A7]no other [Dm]way
to be [G7]happy in [C]Jesus, But to trust and [G7]obey.
Not a shadow can rise,
not a cloud in the skies,
but his smile quickly drives it away;
not a doubt nor a fear,
not a sigh nor a tear,
can abide while we trust and obey.
Not a burden we bear,
not a sorrow we share,
but our toil he doth richly repay;
not a grief or a loss,
not a frown or a cross,
but is blest if we trust and obey.
But we never can prove
the delights of his love
until all on the altar we lay;
for the favor he shows,
and the joy he bestows,
are for them who will trust and obey.
Then in fellowship sweet
we will sit at his feet,
or we'll walk by his side in the way;
what he says we will do,
where he sends we will go;
never fear, only trust and obey.
